_: Rooms shared by their people (src/room.mjs, host.mjs, bond.mjs): the kinds Phiora keeps for them (named apart from the public kinds the data files seed, such as host and room), which no /tree read ever serves; how a direct room between two accounts is named; how much a room answers with; the bounds of what is written; and every word said when something is refused. Read once at start.
